title: YELLOW LIGHT — scatter to green and red. Red bad travels faster than blue slow. Cross-splash the news outside.
yellow: the light we have. eye contact, not yet a hello. sun-colored. do not live in yellow. scatter it.

scatter.green: stance. the readers we keep. slow enough to stand. papers, science, the chair.
scatter.red_bad: fast. scanners, WordPress wasps, the Pareto hill. red arrives first because bad travel is quicker. do not chase it.
scatter.blue_slow: listen. log. the digest. France in the morning, Germany in sessions. blue is late and that is the point.
scatter.red_beacon: a different red. the news we choose to release. slow to aim, then it leaves. this is the splash, not the wasp.

mix: bounce the news (feed) and cross-splash it OUTSIDE the Cloudflare room, onto the GitHub clothes, so the org has a face and not only a stack diagram.

abc.was: /abc/ knocked 38 times. alphabet canary. no page. no face.
abc.now: https://hud.primals.eco/abc/ — the yellow scatter in one alphabet.
abc.clothes: https://github.com/ecoPrimals — profile README is the veil. face painted on it. body of the stack stays.
